summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Dimensional US Large Cap Core Equity Market ETF (DFAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. DFAL.L is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in a broadly diversified portfolio of US large-cap companies. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. DFAL was launched on Jun 18, 2026 and is issued by Dimensional.

holdings.infoBox: DFAL is an equity ETF with a total of 532 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.61%, Apple at 6.70%, Microsoft at 5.51%, Alphabet at 4.86%, and Amazon.com at 3.65%.
